0022600118.text: The Grizzlies (2-0) make their third trip of the season to Sacramento, where they are 1-0 on the road, riding a two-game winning streak and sitting 2nd in the Southwest, 0.5 games back, and 5th in the West. The Kings (0-2) are on a two-game losing streak, sit 4th in the Pacific and 14th in the West, and have not yet met Memphis this season, though the Grizzlies won their 2025-26 season series 3-1, and Sacramento beat Memphis 123-114 in their most recent meeting, on February 23, 2026, in Memphis. Memphis is missing Zach Edey (out, ankle), while Cedric Coward (wrist sprain) and Karim Lopez (knee bruise) are listed as day-to-day and game-time decisions; Sacramento is without Ben Simmons (out, Achilles surgery), Dylan Cardwell (out, calf strain), and Maxime Raynaud (out, dislocated knee), and Keegan Murray (ankle) is day-to-day and a game-time decision.
